rule: A log entry records an operation or observation. It does not become evidence merely by being written here.

entries.title: Opening emission
entries.body: REM618 entered the public field as the first identified KXTXR emission.
entries.decision: Preserve the signal and its interval rather than immediately replacing it with another release.

entries.title: Unresolved interval
entries.body: The public record does not yet contain a complete canonical account of every social manifestation between REM618 and RETURN.
entries.decision: Do not reconstruct missing distribution as if it had been observed.

entries.title: Return window opened
entries.body: KXTXR re-enters the REM618 → 111 trajectory as a bounded return experiment.
entries.decision: Observe external response before interpretation. Preserve missing values as missing.
